name: dokturek-work
description: Marketplace týmu Doktůrek.ai pro práci mimo vývoj: produkt, obchod, marketing, podpora ordinací, právo, provoz, texty rozhraní a analýza dat.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: Run Doktůrek product work outside clinical screen design: non-clinical specs, roadmap changes as diffs to dokturek-docs, weekly sprints on GitHub milestones, stakeholder updates, research synthesis and brainstorming. Clinical EHR specs go to the ehr-design plugin.

plugins.name: sales
plugins.description: Prepare and follow up sales conversations with Czech practices for Doktůrek: research a practice, prep and summarize calls, draft outreach, handle objections, compare with incumbent AIS products and review the Pipedrive pipeline. Drafts only; nothing is sent or written without confirmation.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Plan campaigns and draft marketing content for Doktůrek in Czech: newsletter and email sequences for doctors, landing-page and social copy, brand-voice review against DESIGN.md, and SEO audits of dokturek.ai and get.dokturek.ai. Drafts only.

plugins.name: customer-support
plugins.description: Support Czech practices using Doktůrek: triage requests, draft replies to doctors, package escalations to the right owner, research answers in dokturek-docs and write knowledge-base articles. Patient identifiers are removed; drafts only.

plugins.name: legal
plugins.description: Prepare legal working documents for Doktůrek (Clementine Solutions s.r.o.): review contracts and DPAs with practices, triage NDAs, check GDPR and DPA/DPIA status, assess legal risk, draft responses to legal requests and check vendors as sub-processors. Not legal advice; MDR and AI Act go to the mdr-compliance plugin.

plugins.name: operations
plugins.description: Support Doktůrek operations: incident response with the right owners and the eRecept manual-resolution rule, deploy checklists for Coolify, change requests, capacity planning, technical-debt triage and business process documentation. Never deploys, restarts or changes infrastructure.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Write and review Czech UI copy in the Doktůrek vocabulary and run WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility reviews against the DESIGN.md rules. Clinical screen design and human-factors review go to the ehr-design plugin.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Analyze Doktůrek data safely: write SQL for PostgreSQL or the Firebird AIS copy, explore datasets through schema and aggregates, run statistics on pilot-sized samples, build charts and dashboards in the Doktůrek palette, and validate analyses before sharing. Never handles patient-level data.
